declarations.name: AuiSparkline

inputs.name: label
inputs.description: What the values are, for example "Revenue, last 12 months"; starts the accessible name.

inputs.name: values
inputs.description: Values in order; null, NaN, and infinities are gaps.

inputs.name: variant
inputs.description: Line or bars (bars include zero and draw negatives below a baseline).

inputs.name: valueFormat
inputs.description: Number format for the accessible name.

inputs.name: formatValue
inputs.description: Custom value text for the accessible name.

inputs.name: theme
inputs.description: Look and feel: { palette?: string[] (1-8 CSS colors for slots 1-8); fontFamily?; fontSize? (8-32 px); textColor?; gridLines?: boolean; gridColor?; gridDash? ("4 2" or "none"); axisColor?; lineWidth? (0.5-12 px); markerSize? (1-20 px); cornerRadius?, barRadius?, cellRadius?, sliceRadius?, boxRadius? (0-50 px); swatchRadius? (0-8 px); tooltipRadius?, controlRadius? (0-50 px); lineJoin?: 'round' | 'miter' | 'bevel'; areaOpacity? (0-1); gradient?: boolean; valueLabelColor?; tooltip?: { background?, color?, borderColor? }; legendPosition?: 'top' | 'bottom' | 'start' | 'end'; animation?: boolean | { duration?: number (0-5000 ms) } }. Applied as --aui-chart-* custom properties and classes on the host through the CSSOM (CSP-safe); colors are validated with CSS.supports('color'). Animation is opt-in and never runs with prefers-reduced-motion: reduce or [data-aui-animation='none']. The sparkline uses palette, lineWidth, axisColor (bar baseline), and animation.

inputs.name: highlightLast
inputs.description: Mark the last value (dot for line, full opacity for bar).

inputs.name: direction
inputs.description: rtl mirrors the category/x axis, the value axis side, and Left/Right arrow keys.

accessibility.pattern: Static informative image: svg role="img" with a generated accessible name (WAI Images tutorial, informative images).

limitations: Not interactive: no tooltip or keyboard access to individual values.
Min and max are not marked visually (only the last value).
